about: Measurable rules Mann's QC enforces. When the owner corrects an edit, /studio-learn records the rule in studio/LEARNINGS.md (Editor) and, if it is measurable, tightens a threshold here and adds a history entry. Newest owner rule wins.

history.source: director edit-for-retention rules (visual change every 1.5-3 s in Shorts, no dead air over 1 s)
